name: TRIZ Physical Contradiction Resolution (Separation Principles)
sprint: State the physical contradiction: "Component X must have Property P to satisfy Requirement 1, and Property NOT-P to satisfy Requirement 2." Map how X can be P in Time 1 and NOT-P in Time 2, or P in Space A and NOT-P in Space B.
mechanism: Dialectical decomposition. Resolves mutual exclusivity by separating conflicting parameters across time, space, condition, or system scale.
questions: How can this component be totally open and completely secure at different points in time?
Where can this parameter be rigid at the macro-scale while remaining flexible at the micro-scale?
Under what conditional state can Property P convert into Property NOT-P dynamically?
example: Read Concurrency vs. Write Isolation in High-Throughput Databases. Physical Contradiction: "The database record must be mutable to allow immediate write operations, but immutable to allow non-blocking concurrent reads." Separation in Time and Condition via Multi-Version Concurrency Control (MVCC): records are never updated in place. When a write occurs, a new immutable version is appended with a timestamp. Readers inspect point-in-time snapshots without acquiring locks, eliminating read/write blocking.
